title: Account

anonymous.title: You are using the app without an account
anonymous.body: Create an account to keep your pet's health records and not lose your data if you switch devices.

about.title: About
about.disclaimer: Pet Care is not an official reporting channel and never suggests medicine, dose or diagnosis: it only records what the veterinarian prescribed and reminds you.

signOutConfirmBody: Your data stays saved. To see it again, just sign in.
signOutAnonymousBody: You have no account: if you sign out, data kept only on this device (e.g. saved reports) may be lost.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: This action is permanent. We will erase:

items.pets: the pets you registered, with photos and history (including for people the pet was shared with);
items.own: rescues, reports, favorites and suggestions made by you;

delete.sharedNote: Pets that other people shared with you are not deleted: only your access to them.
delete.done: Your account and data were deleted.
delete.confirmBody: You will not be able to recover your account or data after this.

devEmulators: Development mode: the app is connected to the emulators on your computer. The data is test data and disappears when you close the emulators.
